away.summary: The Sabres are set for their season opener with a projected lineup featuring Josh Norris, Tage Thompson, and Josh Doan on the top line. Key defensive questions remain with Samuelsson and Zellweger day-to-day, while Luukkonen is projected to start in goal after full practice participation. The team plans to dress seven healthy defensemen, suggesting potential roster moves if Samuelsson or Zellweger aren't ready.

home.summary: The Blue Jackets announced their 21-man season-opening roster, which includes Cam Talbot and Jet Greaves as the two goaltenders, with Talbot projected to start. The roster reflects the recent trade that sent Kirill Marchenko to Toronto and brought Matthew Knies back to Columbus, along with Steven Lorentz and Emil Andrae. Key defensive absences include Fabbro, Provorov, Severson, and Lundestrom, all dealing with various injuries.
